format: Microsoft Compound File Binary containing Outlook Item File IPM.Note
default_filename: SOMA-{msg_draft_id}.msg; operator may select another filesystem-safe name
verification: independent reader returns exact normalized subject/body/recipient snapshot
artifact SHA-256 and byte length computed after final bytes
release compatibility fixtures open in supported Outlook on Windows
publication: write/verify sibling temporary file then atomic replace/rename to chosen destination where filesystem supports; never overwrite PST/OST source path; failure is surfaced and no sending evidence is created
provenance: DB stores draft/export identity, artifact hash/size and optional non-raw location fingerprint; audit excludes path/content/recipient addresses
rule: later observed sent item reconciles as provenance only after normal PST/OST canonical identity/matching; draft identity is never replaced
